item_name: IV Medications (O0110H1, with sub-elements H2 Vasoactive medications, H3 Antibiotics, H4 Anticoagulation, H10 Other)

lookback_source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

lookback_notes: O0110 is a three-column item with different assessment periods per column. Column b (While a Resident) uses the last 14 days (also described on p. O-2 as "the 14-day look-back period"). Column a (On Admission) uses days 1-3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; column c (At Discharge) uses the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C (p. O-3). lookback_days is recorded as 14 for the While a Resident column; the two 3-day windows are documented here and in conflicts.

coding_levels.label: IV Medications
coding_levels.definition: Any drug or biological given by intravenous push, epidural pump, or drip through a central or peripheral port.

source.quote:
O0110H1, IV medications
Code any drug or biological given by intravenous push, epidural pump, or drip through a central or peripheral port in this item.

coding_levels.label: Vasoactive medications
coding_levels.definition: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV vasoactive medication.

source.quote:
O0110H2, Vasoactive medications
Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV vasoactive medication.

coding_levels.label: Antibiotics
coding_levels.definition: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV antibiotic.

source.quote:
O0110H3, Antibiotics
Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV antibiotic.

coding_levels.label: Anticoagulation
coding_levels.definition: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV anticoagulant. Subcutaneous administration of anticoagulant medications is not included.

source.quote: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV anticoagulant. Do not include subcutaneous administration of anticoagulant medications.

coding_levels.label: Other
coding_levels.definition: Check when at least one of the IV medications was not an IV vasoactive medication, IV antibiotic, or IV anticoagulant (e.g., IV analgesics, IV diuretics).

source.quote: Check when at least one of the IV medications was not an IV vasoactive medication, IV antibiotic, or IV anticoagulant. Examples include IV analgesics (e.g., morphine) and IV diuretics (e.g., furosemide).

coding_levels.label: Column a. On Admission
coding_levels.definition: Received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1-3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

coding_levels.label: Column b. While a Resident
coding_levels.definition: Received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs that the resident received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days.

coding_levels.label: Column c. At Discharge
coding_levels.definition: Received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

coding_levels.label: None of the above
coding_levels.definition: Code if none of the treatments, procedures, or programs listed in O0110 were received or performed by the resident.

source.quote:
O0110Z1, None of the above
Code if none of the above treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed by the resident.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Code any drug or biological given by intravenous push, epidural pump, or drip through a central or peripheral port.

source.quote: Code any drug or biological given by intravenous push, epidural pump, or drip through a central or peripheral port in this item.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not code flushes to keep an IV access port patent, or IV fluids without medication.

source.quote: Do not code flushes to keep an IV access port patent, or IV fluids without medication here.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Epidural, intrathecal, and baclofen pumps may be coded here.

source.quote: Epidural, intrathecal, and baclofen pumps may be coded here, as they are similar to IV medications in that they must be monitored frequently and they involve continuous administration of a substance.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Subcutaneous pumps are not coded in this item.

source.quote: Subcutaneous pumps are not coded in this item.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not include IV medications of any kind that were administered during dialysis or chemotherapy.

source.quote: Do not include IV medications of any kind that were administered during dialysis or chemotherapy.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Lactated Ringers given IV is not considered a medication and should not be coded here.

source.quote: Lactated Ringers given IV is not considered a medication and should not be coded here.

federal_coding_rules.rule: IVs, IV medication, and blood transfusions administered during chemotherapy are not recorded under O0110H (IV Medications).

source.quote: IVs, IV medication, and blood transfusions administered during chemotherapy are not recorded under items K0520A (Parenteral/IV), O0110H (IV Medications), or O0110I (Transfusions).

federal_coding_rules.rule: IVs, IV medication, and blood transfusions administered during dialysis are considered part of the dialysis procedure and are not to be coded under O0110H (IV medications).

source.quote: IVs, IV medication, and blood transfusions administered during dialysis are considered part of the dialysis procedure and are not to be coded under items K0520A (Parenteral/IV), O0110H (IV medications), or O0110I (transfusions).

federal_coding_rules.rule: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

source.quote: Facilities may code treatments, programs and procedures that the resident performed themselves independently or after set-up by facility staff.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators; surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

source.quote: Do not code services that were provided solely in conjunction with a surgical procedure or diagnostic procedure, such as IV medications or ventilators. Surgical procedures include routine pre- and post-operative procedures.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column a (On Admission): check if received/performed on days 1-3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B; if none in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures, or programs were received or performed in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column b (While a Resident): check if received or performed after admission/entry or reentry to the facility and within the last 14 days; if none within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: If no treatments, procedures or programs were received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident within the last 14 days or since admission/entry or reentry, check Z, None of the above.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Column c (At Discharge): check if received/performed in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C; if none in the 3-day assessment period, check Z, None of the above.

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Check H2 Vasoactive medications when at least one of the IV medications was an IV vasoactive medication.

source.quote: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV vasoactive medication.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Check H3 Antibiotics when at least one of the IV medications was an IV antibiotic.

source.quote: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV antibiotic.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Check H4 Anticoagulation when at least one of the IV medications was an IV anticoagulant; do not include subcutaneous administration of anticoagulant medications.

source.quote: Check when at least one of the IV medications was an IV anticoagulant. Do not include subcutaneous administration of anticoagulant medications.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Check H10 Other when at least one of the IV medications was not an IV vasoactive medication, IV antibiotic, or IV anticoagulant.

source.quote: Check when at least one of the IV medications was not an IV vasoactive medication, IV antibiotic, or IV anticoagulant.

federal.criterion: Review the resident's medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

source.quote: Review the resident’s medical record to determine whether or not the resident received or performed any of the treatments, procedures, or programs within the assessment period defined for each column.

federal.notes: Stated as the Step for Assessment for O0110.

federal.criterion: Resources and tools providing information on medications are available in Section N of the manual (see the end of item N0415 following the Example).

source.quote: Resources and tools providing information on medications are available in Section N of this manual (see the end of item N0415 following the Example).

federal.notes: Offered as a resource pointer, not a documentation requirement.

case_mix_relevance.notes: The supplied pages tie O0110 columns a and c to the SNF PPS Stay dates (A2400B/A2400C) but do not explicitly state that O0110H drives a payment or case-mix classification.

conflicts.topic: Multiple coexisting assessment/look-back windows for O0110 (and therefore O0110H)

positions.claim: The item rationale describes a 14-day look-back period for the treatments, procedures, and programs in O0110.

source.quote: Reevaluation of special treatments and procedures the resident received or performed, or programs that the resident was involved in during the 14-day look-back period is important to ensure the continued appropriateness of the treatments, procedures, or programs.

positions.claim: Column a uses a 3-day assessment period (days 1-3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B).

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident on days 1–3 of the SNF PPS Stay starting with A2400B.

positions.claim: Column c uses a 3-day assessment period (last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C).

source.quote: Check all treatments, procedures, and programs received by, performed on, or participated in by the resident in the last 3 days of the SNF PPS Stay ending with A2400C.

conflicts.resolution: Resolved by the document itself: the manual states the assessment period is defined separately for each column — 3 days for columns a and c, and the last 14 days for column b (p. O-3). The "14-day look-back period" phrasing on p. O-2 refers to the While a Resident column.
